title: Vector arithmetic, hex and nesting
teaches: Expressions are prefix forms: nesting, not infix precedence, decides evaluation order. Arithmetic is variadic and left-folds, unary minus is the one-argument form of -, and 0x hex literals are ordinary numbers.
observe: (* 2 (+ 3 4)) is 14 because the inner form evaluates first.
gain grows by 16 per beat from a 16-at-beat-0 floor.
